verdict.rationale: Casium runs a real software surface (a client portal and case dashboard), so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The evidence covers attorney services, case tracking, and visa guides only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
